# Reader test data

`combo-kf8.mobi` is a 1.7 KiB synthetic book generated by
`testComboKF8(t, "EBOK")` in `internal/format/mobi/mobi_test.go`.
Its primary MOBI6 text is `Legacy MOBI6`; its secondary KF8 text is
`Hello Combo KF8`. It includes skeleton, fragment and navigation indexes,
a one-pixel image, and dummy audio/video records. No real-book content is used.

The browser test opens this book through Polka and checks that its KF8 text
is displayed. Keeping it outside `fixtures/` excludes it from the
library seeded for unrelated browser tests.

`reflowable.kfx` is generated by `testfixture.KFX(t, false)` in
`internal/testfixture/kfx.go`. It contains two short chapters, inline emphasis,
a footnote and backlink, Arabic text, a table with top-aligned cells, and a
centered four-pixel-square image also used as the cover.
A tiny embedded font is shared by two family names. All content and assets are
synthetic and owned by the project. The browser test checks the complete import
and reading path, chapter navigation, and preservation of the original download.

`fixed.kfx` is generated by `testfixture.KFXFixed(t)` in
`internal/testfixture/kfx_fixed.go`. Four project-owned image pages exercise a
single cover, a right-to-left pair and a centered landscape spread. Their
structure follows observed comic page templates. The browser test checks that
the reader opens the paired pages in the correct order and the wide page alone.

`japanese.kfx` is generated by `testfixture.KFXJapanese(t)` in
`internal/testfixture/kfx.go`. Project-owned Japanese text exercises vertical
writing, horizontal combined digits, ruby with overlapping bold, colored emphasis
marks, and links whose destinations follow annotated text. The structures were
checked against independently generated KFX from project-owned EPUBs.
